apps.name: Team Generator: Random Picker
apps.tagline: Fair teams and random name draws for classrooms, coaches and trainers.
stores: Rosters you create — the roster name and the list of names you type or paste.
Optional skill ratings you attach to a name so teams come out balanced.
Your settings: number of teams, appearance, and whether the app is unlocked.
help: Make fair teams
Open the Teams tab, choose how many teams you want, and tap Make teams. Add a skill rating to any name on the Rosters tab and the split balances on that rating instead of splitting at random.
Draw names without repeats
The Wheel tab draws from the roster without replacement — nobody comes up twice until the pool empties. Tap Undo to put the last name back.
Paste a class list
Rosters tab, Add roster, then paste names one per line. Anything you can copy out of a spreadsheet or a gradebook works.
Show it on the projector
Tap Projector mode for oversized, high-contrast cards that read from the back of a room.
Move to a new device
Export a roster to CSV from the Rosters tab and import it on the other device. Rosters are stored only on the device, so they do not travel on their own.
Restore your purchase
Settings, then Restore Purchase. Use the same Apple Account that bought the unlock; the unlock is a one-time purchase and never expires.

apps.name: Axle Weight & Slide Calc
apps.tagline: Work out the tandem slide from a scale ticket, before you pull off the scale.
stores: Weighings you save — the axle weights you typed and the result the app worked out.
Rigs you set up — hole spacing, axle spacing and the names you give them.
Your settings: units, appearance, and whether the app is unlocked.
help: Read the answer

Type the steer, drive and trailer weights off the scale ticket. The headline tells you which way to slide and how many holes; the diagram shows the move; the badge tells you whether the rig is legal after it.
Which way is FORWARD

Forward means toward the tractor. Sliding the trailer tandems forward moves weight off the drives and onto the trailer axles; sliding them back does the opposite. Slide toward the group that is overweight to lighten it.
Where the limits come from

The Limits screen names its source and the date it was checked: 80,000 lb gross, 20,000 lb single, 34,000 lb tandem and the federal bridge formula from 23 CFR 658.17, plus California's kingpin rule. These are the federal Interstate limits. Non-Interstate state routes can be lower — always verify against current state law.
Set up your own trailer
Rigs let you save hole spacing and axle spacing per trailer, so the hole count matches the trailer you are actually pulling.
Get the numbers out
Weigh history exports to CSV from the history screen for your own records.
Restore your purchase
Settings, then Restore Purchase. Use the same Apple Account that bought the unlock; the unlock is a one-time purchase and never expires.
